crossToolNote.zh: 无遥测越权（读取 ~/.claude 与 ~/.codex 仅用于会话导入与技能发现）
crossToolNote.en: Core only (reads ~/.claude & ~/.codex only for session import & skill discovery)

oneLiner.zh: Rust 后端严格默认关闭 PostHog（unwrap_or(false)），无硬件指纹、无跨工具窥探；小扣分是桌面首次引导复选框默认打勾且不认 DO_NOT_TRACK。
oneLiner.en: Rust backend strictly enforces opt-in PostHog (`unwrap_or(false)`) with random UUIDv4 and no cross-tool snooping; minor note: desktop onboarding checkbox is pre-checked.

title.zh: 后端默认关闭，桌面首次引导复选框预勾选
title.en: Backend strictly opt-in; desktop onboarding checkbox pre-checked

summary.zh: crates/goose/src/posthog.rs 默认返回 false；桌面端 OnboardingSuccess.tsx:51 默认 useState(true)。
summary.en: `is_telemetry_enabled()` defaults to `false` in Rust; desktop onboarding initializes checkbox with `useState(true)`.

mitigationNote.zh: 设置 GOOSE_TELEMETRY_OFF=1 即可确保全局禁用。
mitigationNote.en: Set GOOSE_TELEMETRY_OFF=1 or uncheck telemetry during desktop onboarding.
